## Job description
**Data Analyst, Operations Insights** (fictional test posting)

Our operations teams still build most of their weekly reporting by hand in spreadsheets. We want to replace manual weekly reporting with self-serve dashboards, improve the reliability of our data pipelines and create a single source of truth for operational KPIs.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain Power BI dashboards for operations and finance
- Model data in dbt on top of Snowflake
- Define and document KPIs with operations and finance stakeholders
- Monitor and improve scheduled data loads

What we're looking for
- Strong SQL
- Hands-on Power BI
- Experience with dbt and Snowflake
- Confident stakeholder management with non-technical teams

Nice to have
- Python for automation
- Airflow or a similar orchestrator
- Looker
- Data modelling experience

## Company brief
Northwind Logistics runs a same-day freight network across the north of England, with about 900 staff. Values: own it, keep it simple. Data stack: Snowflake, dbt, Power BI, Airflow.
